escalation.verdict: Bumping to b12546 got the src hash (sha256-XSThz7B6JIPhl/og0gr+G/IsQoct0SW8IAFXEdKo5/Y=) but the npm-deps build fails with 'pushd: tools/ui: No such file or directory'. The webui directory (npmRoot) has moved again at b12546, just as it did at b10375 (tools/server/webui -> tools/ui). That is why bump-overlays could not resolve npmDepsHash. I could not find the new path because the sandbox blocked reading the fetched source in the Nix store, GitHub API access, and WebFetch. I reverted my edits, so the overlay and updates.json still pin 12292. A human needs to find where package-lock.json lives at tag b12546 (for example `nix build` the src and look under tools/), set npmRoot to that path, blank npmDepsHash, rebuild to read the hash, and bump version, tag, src hash and updates.json current_version together. If upstream restructured the webui build (a different build tool or no committed lockfile), nixpkgs' package.nix preConfigure/npm handling may also need changes.
